findings.text: follow-on: the .in-use branch returns False whenever the lease record names any node, so a tree whose record still names a host that stopped renewing more than COMMITTED_TREE_LEASE_WINDOW_SECONDS ago is not spared by recency, and a third host sitting between pin_materialized_tree's flock at :212 and its _record_lease_node at :216 in that state is pruned out from under; the window is a couple of syscalls wide, narrower than the gap d0d313b2 closed, so it does not reopen that hole but is the same class.

follow-on: on the retry the first materialize_committed_tree call's removed and kept lists are discarded, so a prune the failed attempt performed is absent from the seat's reload_prune record and a reader comparing two reloads sees fewer removals than happened.

follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite are recorded as prose, so reckon.crew.review.annotate_review_of_run over the manifest fields returns an unmeasured count and a reader cannot tie the reviewed run's suite delta to a log without opening the run directory by hand, though the arm logs on disk make the delta derivable.
